data.body: AC5 evidence - review-plan run INSIDE the Claude Code Bash sandbox (allowed_domains: api.anthropic.com only), rebar CLI from cli-main built at c8118c62e81 (the merged fix). Run 1 (17:26-17:36 PST, log .rebar/scratch/bluewhale-05f74084/review-plan-sandboxed.log): real verdict BLOCK on plan wording (E4 root-cause premise), 0 indeterminate, no connection errors. Run 2 (17:37-17:43, review-plan-sandboxed-2.log): BLOCK from the deterministic description-size floor after the plan was corrected (9237 > 8000 chars). Run 3 (17:51-17:59, review-plan-sandboxed-3.log): signed PASS, 0 blocking, 14 advisory, 0 indeterminate, exit 0. Every LLM call in all 3 runs reached api.anthropic.com through the sandbox proxy; the only gaierror/ConnectError strings in the logs are quotes inside findings. Before the fix the same command in the same sandbox returned INDETERMINATE with gaierror 8. Description corrected in between: root-cause premise fixed, loopback/unusable-proxy/env-only differences stated; acceptance criteria unchanged.
